test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Avarise"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here let's see the correct spelling of the incorrect word with its meaning:

__
 
• **Avarice -** excessive or insatiable desire for wealth or gain

 
 
• ***Eg.*** Adherence to the Baldwin model is usually more a sin of thoughtlessness and convenience than of conscious* avarice*, though it is always an appropriation of moral power, a stealing of thunder.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's learn some other given words with their meanings:

 
• **Admonish -** to indicate duties or obligations to

 
 
• ***Eg. ***Students were *admonished* for being late.
 
 
 
• **Adverse - **acting against or in a contrary direction
 
 
• ***Eg.*** hindered by* adverse* winds.
 
 
 
• **Beige - **of a color that is light grayish-yellowish brown
 
 
• ***Eg.*** She is wearing a* beige *skirt.
